SELECT c.id AS source_numeric_id, 'GOOD_FEED' AS source_kind, 'mes_report_material_consume' AS source_table, a.task_code AS task_code, a.produce_task_code AS produce_task_code, c.arrange_code AS arrange_code, c.feed_id AS feed_id, NULL AS stock_id, c.report_id AS report_id, 'GOOD' AS report_domain, c.report_id AS root_id, c.report_request_id AS request_id, c.mat_code AS actual_material_code, c.requirement_mat_code AS requirement_material_code, c.mat_batch AS batch_no, c.mat_barcode AS barcode, f.mat_unit AS unit, NULL AS requirement_unit, CAST(c.consume_num AS text) AS quantity, CAST(c.requirement_num AS text) AS requirement_quantity, CAST(c.substitute_ratio AS text) AS substitute_ratio, c.status AS source_status, CASE WHEN c.reverse_request_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mom_mes.mes_report_quantity_correction_line l WHERE l.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND l.factory_code=c.factory_code AND l.report_id=c.report_id AND l.allocation_type='MATERIAL_CONSUME' AND l.source_id=c.id) THEN 'HAS_RESTORATION' ELSE 'NONE_RECORDED' END AS restoration_status, c.create_time AS occurred_at, r.transfer_code AS product_identifier, r.report_mode AS production_report_mode, CAST(r.report_num AS text) AS production_report_quantity, r.id AS report_found, f.id AS feed_found FROM mom_mes.mes_report_material_consume c JOIN mom_mes.mes_task_arrange a ON a.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND a.factory_code=c.factory_code AND a.code=c.arrange_code LEFT JOIN mom_mes.mes_task_report r ON r.id=c.report_id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.factory_code=c.factory_code AND r.task_code=a.task_code AND r.arrange_code=a.code AND r.produce_task_code=a.produce_task_code AND r.request_id=c.report_request_id LEFT JOIN mom_mes.mes_warehouse_feed f ON f.id=c.feed_id AND f.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND f.factory_code=c.factory_code AND f.task_code=a.task_code AND f.arrange_code=a.code AND f.mat_code=c.mat_code AND (f.mat_batch=c.mat_batch OR (f.mat_batch IS NULL AND c.mat_batch IS NULL)) AND (f.mat_barcode=c.mat_barcode OR (f.mat_barcode IS NULL AND c.mat_barcode IS NULL)) WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.factory_code=#{factory} AND a.task_code=#{q.taskCode} UNION ALL SELECT c.id AS source_numeric_id, 'GOOD_BACKFLUSH' AS source_kind, 'mes_warehouse_inout' AS source_table, a.task_code AS task_code, a.produce_task_code AS produce_task_code, c.bill_no AS arrange_code, NULL AS feed_id, c.source_stock_id AS stock_id, c.bill_id AS report_id, 'GOOD' AS report_domain, c.bill_id AS root_id, c.resource_no AS request_id, c.mat_code AS actual_material_code, c.requirement_mat_code AS requirement_material_code, c.mat_batch AS batch_no, c.mat_barcode AS barcode, c.mat_unit AS unit, NULL AS requirement_unit, CAST(c.operate_num AS text) AS quantity, NULL AS requirement_quantity, CAST(c.substitute_ratio AS text) AS substitute_ratio, r.status AS source_status, CASE WHEN r.reverse_request_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mom_mes.mes_report_quantity_correction_line l WHERE l.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND l.factory_code=c.factory_code AND l.report_id=c.bill_id AND l.allocation_type='MATERIAL_FLOW' AND l.source_id=c.id) THEN 'HAS_RESTORATION' ELSE 'NONE_RECORDED' END AS restoration_status, c.create_time AS occurred_at, r.transfer_code AS product_identifier, r.report_mode AS production_report_mode, CAST(r.report_num AS text) AS production_report_quantity, r.id AS report_found, NULL AS feed_found FROM mom_mes.mes_warehouse_inout c JOIN mom_mes.mes_task_arrange a ON a.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND a.factory_code=c.factory_code AND a.code=c.bill_no LEFT JOIN mom_mes.mes_task_report r ON r.id=c.bill_id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.factory_code=c.factory_code AND r.task_code=a.task_code AND r.arrange_code=a.code AND r.produce_task_code=a.produce_task_code AND r.request_id=c.resource_no WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.factory_code=#{factory} AND a.task_code=#{q.taskCode} AND c.biz_type='back_flush_out' AND c.operate_type='out' UNION ALL SELECT c.id AS source_numeric_id, 'NG_FEED' AS source_kind, 'mes_production_material_allocation' AS source_table, b.task_code AS task_code, b.produce_task_code AS produce_task_code, b.arrange_code AS arrange_code, c.feed_id AS feed_id, NULL AS stock_id, c.source_unqualified_report_id AS report_id, 'NG' AS report_domain, b.id AS root_id, b.request_id AS request_id, c.mat_code AS actual_material_code, c.requirement_mat_code AS requirement_material_code, f.mat_batch AS batch_no, f.mat_barcode AS barcode, c.mat_unit AS unit, c.requirement_unit AS requirement_unit, CAST(c.consume_num AS text) AS quantity, CAST(c.requirement_num AS text) AS requirement_quantity, NULL AS substitute_ratio, b.status AS source_status, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mom_mes.mes_production_material_restore z WHERE z.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND z.factory_code=c.factory_code AND z.operation_id=c.operation_id AND z.feed_id=c.feed_id) THEN 'HAS_RESTORATION' ELSE 'NONE_RECORDED' END AS restoration_status, c.create_time AS occurred_at, n.transfer_code AS product_identifier, n.report_mode AS production_report_mode, CAST(n.unqualified_num AS text) AS production_report_quantity, n.id AS report_found, f.id AS feed_found FROM mom_mes.mes_production_material_allocation c JOIN mom_mes.mes_production_material_operation b ON b.id=c.operation_id AND b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND b.factory_code=c.factory_code AND b.source_unqualified_report_id=c.source_unqualified_report_id LEFT JOIN mom_mes.mes_warehouse_feed f ON f.id=c.feed_id AND f.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND f.factory_code=c.factory_code AND f.task_code=b.task_code AND f.arrange_code=b.arrange_code AND f.mat_code=c.mat_code LEFT JOIN mom_mes.mes_task_report_unqualified n ON n.id=c.source_unqualified_report_id AND n.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND n.factory_code=c.factory_code AND n.task_code=b.task_code AND n.arrange_code=b.arrange_code AND n.produce_task_code=b.produce_task_code AND n.request_id=b.request_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.factory_code=#{factory} AND b.task_code=#{q.taskCode} UNION ALL SELECT c.id AS source_numeric_id, 'COMBINED_FEED' AS source_kind, 'mes_production_feed_consumption' AS source_table, b.task_code AS task_code, b.produce_task_code AS produce_task_code, b.arrange_code AS arrange_code, c.feed_id AS feed_id, NULL AS stock_id, NULL AS report_id, NULL AS report_domain, b.id AS root_id, b.request_id AS request_id, c.mat_code AS actual_material_code, c.requirement_mat_code AS requirement_material_code, f.mat_batch AS batch_no, f.mat_barcode AS barcode, c.mat_unit AS unit, c.requirement_unit AS requirement_unit, CAST(c.consume_num AS text) AS quantity, CAST(c.requirement_num AS text) AS requirement_quantity, NULL AS substitute_ratio, b.status AS source_status, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mom_mes.mes_production_feed_restore_line z WHERE z.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND z.factory_code=c.factory_code AND z.consumption_id=c.id AND z.feed_id=c.feed_id) THEN 'HAS_RESTORATION' ELSE 'NONE_RECORDED' END AS restoration_status, c.create_time AS occurred_at, NULL AS product_identifier, NULL AS production_report_mode, NULL AS production_report_quantity, NULL AS report_found, f.id AS feed_found FROM mom_mes.mes_production_feed_consumption c JOIN mom_mes.mes_production_feed_batch b ON b.id=c.batch_id AND b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND b.factory_code=c.factory_code LEFT JOIN mom_mes.mes_warehouse_feed f ON f.id=c.feed_id AND f.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND f.factory_code=c.factory_code AND f.task_code=b.task_code AND f.arrange_code=b.arrange_code AND f.mat_code=c.mat_code
WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.factory_code=#{factory} AND b.task_code=#{q.taskCode} UNION ALL SELECT c.id AS source_numeric_id, CASE WHEN c.source_kind='FEED' THEN 'NG_POLICY_FEED' ELSE 'NG_POLICY_BACKFLUSH' END AS source_kind, 'mes_ng_material_policy_allocation' AS source_table, b.task_code AS task_code,b.produce_task_code AS produce_task_code,b.arrange_code AS arrange_code, CASE WHEN c.source_kind='FEED' THEN c.source_id ELSE NULL END AS feed_id, CASE WHEN c.source_kind='STOCK' THEN c.source_id ELSE NULL END AS stock_id, b.source_unqualified_report_id AS report_id,'NG' AS report_domain,b.id AS root_id,b.request_id AS request_id, c.mat_code AS actual_material_code,c.requirement_mat_code AS requirement_material_code, CASE WHEN c.source_kind='FEED' THEN f.mat_batch ELSE original_out.mat_batch END AS batch_no, CASE WHEN c.source_kind='FEED' THEN f.mat_barcode ELSE original_out.mat_barcode END AS barcode, c.mat_unit AS unit,c.requirement_unit AS requirement_unit,CAST(c.quantity AS text) AS quantity, CAST(c.requirement_quantity AS text) AS requirement_quantity,CAST(c.substitute_ratio AS text) AS substitute_ratio, 'MATERIAL_RECORDED' AS source_status, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mom_mes.mes_ng_material_policy_restore z WHERE z.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND z.factory_code=c.factory_code AND z.operation_id=c.operation_id AND z.allocation_id=c.id AND z.source_kind=c.source_kind AND z.source_id=c.source_id) THEN 'HAS_RESTORATION' ELSE 'NONE_RECORDED' END AS restoration_status, n.report_time AS occurred_at,n.transfer_code AS product_identifier,n.report_mode AS production_report_mode, CAST(n.unqualified_num AS text) AS production_report_quantity,n.id AS report_found,f.id AS feed_found FROM mom_mes.mes_ng_material_policy_allocation c JOIN mom_mes.mes_ng_material_policy_operation b ON b.id=c.operation_id AND b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND b.factory_code=c.factory_code AND b.evidence_version='MES_NG_MATERIAL_POLICY_V1' LEFT JOIN mom_mes.mes_warehouse_feed f ON c.source_kind='FEED' AND f.id=c.source_id AND f.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND f.factory_code=c.factory_code AND f.task_code=b.task_code AND f.arrange_code=b.arrange_code AND f.mat_code=c.mat_code AND f.mat_unit=c.mat_unit LEFT JOIN mom_mes.mes_warehouse_inout original_out ON c.source_kind='STOCK' AND original_out.id=c.source_flow_id AND original_out.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND original_out.factory_code=c.factory_code AND original_out.source_stock_id=c.source_id AND original_out.bill_id=b.source_unqualified_report_id AND original_out.bill_no=b.arrange_code AND original_out.resource_no=b.request_id AND original_out.mat_code=c.mat_code AND original_out.mat_unit=c.mat_unit AND original_out.biz_type='production_ng_material_out' AND original_out.operate_type='out' LEFT JOIN mom_mes.mes_task_report_unqualified n ON n.id=b.source_unqualified_report_id AND n.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND n.factory_code=b.factory_code AND n.task_code=b.task_code AND n.produce_task_code=b.produce_task_code AND n.arrange_code=b.arrange_code AND n.request_id=b.request_id AND n.source_fingerprint=b.source_fingerprint WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.factory_code=#{factory} AND b.task_code=#{q.taskCode} AND c.source_kind IN ('FEED','STOCK')

sql.if: AND x.report_id=CAST(#{q.reportId} AS bigint) AND x.report_domain=#{q.reportDomain}

mapper.select: SELECT x.* FROM () x WHERE x.source_kind=#{kind} AND x.source_numeric_id=#{id}

SELECT r.* FROM
mom_mes.mes_report_material_consume mom_mes.mes_warehouse_inout mom_mes.mes_ng_material_policy_allocation mom_mes.mes_production_material_allocation mom_mes.mes_production_feed_consumption r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.factory_code=#{factory} AND r.id=#{id}

SELECT f.* FROM mom_mes.mes_ng_material_policy_allocation c JOIN mom_mes.mes_ng_material_policy_operation b ON b.id=c.operation_id AND b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND b.factory_code=c.factory_code JOIN mom_mes.mes_warehouse_inout f ON f.id=c.source_flow_id AND f.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND f.factory_code=c.factory_code AND f.source_stock_id=c.source_id AND f.bill_id=b.source_unqualified_report_id AND f.bill_no=b.arrange_code AND f.resource_no=b.request_id AND f.mat_code=c.mat_code AND f.mat_unit=c.mat_unit AND f.biz_type='production_ng_material_out' AND f.operate_type='out' WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.factory_code=#{factory} AND c.id=#{id} AND c.operation_id=#{rootId} AND c.source_kind='STOCK' AND b.task_code=#{task} AND b.produce_task_code=#{produce} AND b.arrange_code=#{arrange}

SELECT o.*,CAST(s.id AS text) AS share_id,CAST(s.consume_num AS text) AS share_quantity, CAST(s.requirement_num AS text) AS share_requirement_quantity FROM mom_mes.mes_production_feed_share s JOIN mom_mes.mes_production_feed_output o ON o.id=s.output_id AND o.batch_id=s.batch_id AND o.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND o.factory_code=s.factory_code WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.factory_code=#{factory} AND s.batch_id=#{rootId} AND s.consumption_id=#{id} ORDER BY s.id

SELECT f.* FROM mom_mes.mes_ng_material_policy_restore l JOIN mom_mes.mes_ng_material_policy_operation b ON b.id=l.operation_id AND b.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND b.factory_code=l.factory_code JOIN mom_mes.mes_ng_material_policy_reversal r ON r.id=l.reversal_id AND r.operation_id=l.operation_id AND r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND r.factory_code=l.factory_code JOIN mom_mes.mes_warehouse_inout f ON f.id=l.restore_flow_id AND f.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND f.factory_code=l.factory_code AND f.source_stock_id=l.source_id AND f.bill_id=r.id AND f.bill_no=b.arrange_code AND f.resource_no=r.request_id AND f.mat_code=l.mat_code AND f.mat_unit=l.mat_unit AND f.biz_type='production_ng_material_restore' AND f.operate_type='in' WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND l.factory_code=#{factory} AND l.operation_id=#{rootId} AND l.allocation_id=#{id} AND l.source_kind='STOCK' AND b.task_code=#{task} AND b.produce_task_code=#{produce} AND b.arrange_code=#{arrange} ORDER BY f.id

choose.when: SELECT receipt.* FROM ( SELECT outgoing.id AS original_id, incoming.id AS receipt_id, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY outgoing.id, incoming.resource_no) AS receipt_count, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY incoming.id) AS original_count FROM mom_mes.mes_task_report report JOIN mom_mes.mes_warehouse_inout outgoing ON outgoing.tenant_id = report.tenant_id AND outgoing.factory_code = report.factory_code AND outgoing.bill_id = report.id AND outgoing.bill_no = report.arrange_code AND outgoing.resource_no = report.request_id AND outgoing.biz_type = 'back_flush_out' AND outgoing.operate_type = 'out' JOIN mom_mes.mes_warehouse_inout incoming ON incoming.tenant_id = outgoing.tenant_id AND incoming.factory_code = outgoing.factory_code AND incoming.bill_id = outgoing.bill_id AND incoming.bill_no = outgoing.bill_no AND incoming.mat_code = outgoing.mat_code AND incoming.mat_unit = outgoing.mat_unit AND incoming.mat_batch IS NOT DISTINCT FROM outgoing.mat_batch AND incoming.mat_barcode IS NOT DISTINCT FROM outgoing.mat_barcode AND incoming.requirement_mat_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM outgoing.requirement_mat_code AND incoming.produce_task_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM outgoing.produce_task_code AND incoming.operate_type = 'in' AND incoming.source_stock_id IS NOT NULL AND ((incoming.biz_type = 'report_correction_material_in' AND incoming.resource_no IS DISTINCT FROM report.reverse_request_id) OR (incoming.biz_type = 'report_reverse_material_in' AND incoming.resource_no = report.reverse_request_id)) LEFT JOIN mom_mes.mes_report_quantity_correction_line line ON line.tenant_id = outgoing.tenant_id AND line.factory_code = outgoing.factory_code AND line.report_id = outgoing.bill_id AND line.source_id = outgoing.id AND line.allocation_type = 'MATERIAL_FLOW' AND line.operation_request_id = incoming.resource_no WHERE report.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND report.factory_code = #{factory} AND report.id = #{rootId} AND report.task_code = #{task} AND report.arrange_code = #{arrange} AND report.produce_task_code = #{produce} AND report.request_id = #{request} AND outgoing.mat_code = #{material} AND ( line.correction_quantity = incoming.operate_num OR (line.id IS NULL AND incoming.biz_type = 'report_reverse_material_in' AND incoming.resource_no = report.reverse_request_id AND incoming.source_stock_id = outgoing.source_stock_id AND incoming.operate_num = outgoing.operate_num AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mom_mes.mes_report_quantity_correction_line other WHERE other.tenant_id = report.tenant_id AND other.factory_code = report.factory_code AND other.report_id = report.id AND other.allocation_type = 'MATERIAL_FLOW' AND other.operation_request_id = incoming.resource_no )) ) ) matched JOIN mom_mes.mes_warehouse_inout receipt ON receipt.id = matched.receipt_id AND receipt.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND receipt.factory_code = #{factory} WHERE matched.original_id = #{id} AND matched.receipt_count = 1 AND matched.original_count = 1 ORDER BY receipt.id
SELECT r.* FROM mom_mes.mes_ng_material_policy_reversal r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.factory_code=#{factory} AND r.operation_id=#{rootId} ORDER BY r.id

SELECT r.* FROM mom_mes.mes_production_feed_reversal r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.factory_code=#{factory} AND r.batch_id=#{rootId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mom_mes.mes_production_feed_restore_line l WHERE l.reversal_id=r.id AND l.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND l.factory_code=r.factory_code AND l.batch_id=r.batch_id AND l.consumption_id=#{id}) ORDER BY r.id
